How about hacking the positions (sort of) by hand?

d.frame <- data.frame(variable=rep(c("read.books","watch.tv"),each=3),
value=rep(c("often","sometimes","never"),2),
frequ=c(150,200,50,50,100,250))

library(ggplot2)

pl <- ggplot(d.frame, aes(x=variable, y=as.numeric(frequ),fill
=value))
pl <- pl + geom_bar(stat="identity",position = "fill")
pl <- pl + coord_flip()
pl <- pl + scale_y_continuous("", formatter="percent")
pl

d2 <- ddply(d.frame,"variable",
function(x) {
x <- x[order(x$value),]
x$cfreq <- cumsum(x$frequ)/sum(x$frequ)
x$pos <- (c(0,x$cfreq[-nrow(x)])+x$cfreq)/2
x
})

pl <- pl + geom_text(data = d2,
aes(x=variable,y=pos,
label=frequ),size=3)
